scope: One construction-only visual authoring review; source preparation now, exact review and separate root admission required before execution.
displayMethod: For only the seven saved resolved curves, convert each existing Catmull-Rom polynomial interval into one SVG cubic using values at interval fractions 0, 1/3, 2/3, 1. Orthographic projection preserves that polynomial. This is display conversion, not a ribbon sampler, new interval allocation, error test, compiler or mesh. No first-guide evaluation. Show the three original endpoint fractions as markers only; curves are guide centres, not ribbon offsets/widths. Reuse stored failing point/chord witnesses without curve reevaluation at those witnesses.
bodyContext: Read the frozen bind-pose body primitive and patched positions. Project existing triangles intersecting y>=1.20 as a gray silhouette. Overlay existing eligible scalp triangles in pale orange using the unchanged allowlist, joint weight and outward-normal checks. No nearest-root search, new anchor or root repair. No occlusion claim: guides, anchors and seeds are intentionally X-ray overlays.
seedDisplay: Nape-03/04 source seed crosses and projected25mm radius circles only. Nape-03 failed; nape-04 was not assessed. Circles visualize the original search radius, not a resolved root or evidence of permitted attachment.

browserReview.route: supported CUA symbolic iab, existing Vite; no native fallback
browserReview.capture: one fixed1024x880 sheet per query view, containing SVG and uncropped portrait1; no camera/pose/light adjustment or repeat capture

questions: Which of the seven paths visibly lacks the intended broad loose-wave shape or has a local control kink worth changing?
Which fixed projections actually reveal that shape, and which parts are ambiguous because the reference is unregistered and only seven centre paths are shown?
Where do the two unresolved nape seeds sit relative to the frozen scalp context, without guessing a new root or nearest distance?
